patch_description: Add certified continuation restarts from the best layout found by the initial hexagonal-layer searches. Dense unequal circle packings often lie in narrow local basins: a moderate radius shrink creates contact slack, while small deterministic center perturbations allow SLSQP to change the active contact graph and recover a better unequal boundary arrangement. The continuation starts use several perturbation magnitudes and accept feasible iterates even when SLSQP reports a non-success line-search status, since the later global scaling step provides the final certificate.
